long_biography.plain_text:
French and Portuguese studies gave Igor Sechin an unusual foundation for a career in administration and energy management. After graduating from Leningrad State University, he worked abroad as an interpreter before joining the municipal administration in St Petersburg.

Rosneft became his principal business institution after he moved through senior federal posts. Sechin first served at board level, then returned as chief executive in 2012. His work now spans daily executive leadership at the major oil producer, the chairmanship of its management board and deputy chairmanship of the board of directors.

proposed_details.existing_value: Igor Ivanovich Sechin is a Russian oligarch and government figure who is Vladimir Putin's close associate and "de facto deputy." Sechin is widely regarded as one of Putin's most orthodox advisers and the leader of the Siloviki faction in the Kremlin, which includes former security service personnel. He was Russia's Deputy Prime Minister in Vladimir Putin's cabinet until May 21, 2012, and he is now the CEO, President, and Chairman of the Management Board of Rosneft, the Russian national oil firm. Darth Vader is his nickname.
